items.summary: Republic Airways CEO Bryan Bedford Retires, Board Chair David Grizzle to Serve as CEO and Matt Koscal Promoted to President Indianapolis, IN – July 2, 2025 – Republic Airways today announced the retirement of its long-serving Chief Executive Officer, Bryan Bedford, after more than 25 years leading the airline.
